source: Scale run 4: hand-disambiguated PDMX composer_name values that gen_pdmx_composers.py skipped (ambiguous Wikidata hit, or credit-year check tripped by publication years). Each entry was resolved by reading the PDMX titles (e.g. Strathspeys/reels -> the Scottish fiddler; psalm settings -> Goudimel) and checking the Wikidata life dates. All died <= 1929. Loaded by schema.py as tier 6, full-name match only.

composers.name: William Marshall
composers.note: Scottish fiddler-composer; PDMX titles are his strathspeys/reels (1781/1822 collections). Other Wikidata William Marshalls are a 1806-1875 organist (also PD) and 20th-c. singers/actors (no match to these titles).

composers.name: Niel Gow
composers.note: Scottish fiddler; his son Niel Gow jr (1794-1823) is also PD. Nathaniel Gow is a separate existing composer (full-name match keeps them apart).
